items.title: Soft Aesthetic Teens
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Time to look fresh in this adorable style. Choose from a range of cozy sweaters, soft pastels, and stylish skirts! 

+ 8 cute teen skins
+ Pretty and pink
+ 1 FREE skin: Bubblegum

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Summer Party
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Summer or not, it's time to throw a Minecraft party! The coolest teens on the server are all coming too so pick your favorite skin, play your favorite gamemodes and just have a good time all the while looking best with these cute and colorful skins!

- 14 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Notorious Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Want to play on your favorite servers, but you don't have any cool skin or are tired of your old one? Look no further! The Notorious Teens skin collection is exactly what you need! Grab your favorite one and be the star you always wanted to be! 

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Legendary Fashion
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Legendary fashion is a collection of the best of the best in a nice package. If your goal is to look cool while playing Minecraft then look no further! With this skin pack, you are sure to be one of the best looking on your favorite server or world! What are you waiting for, go ahead!

- 11 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Dolphins
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Explore the dolphinarium and dive underwater into the pool. Enjoy every kids’ favorite dream: swim and ride 10+ NEW dolphins in a dolphinarium! Perform tricks, jump and breathe underwater as long as you want with potions.

+ Every kids dream: ridable dolphins
+ 10+ NEW dolphins in many colors and sizes
+ Dolphinarium
+ Perform tricks
+ Custom sounds

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Modern Teen Styles
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Want to make a fashion statement through your style? Then these skins are for you, set a trend, and show off your awesome styles in any world you join!

- 10 stylish skins 
- All modern
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Ambient Creations.

items.title: Rebellious Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
The rebellious teens are back in town! And they came to conquer the city! Join them among these 12 awesome skins and start the adventure. The city waits for you!


- 12 cool outfits
- 1 free skin
- Licensed by Dragon Blocks and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: World Adventurers
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Discover the secrets that every adventurer of the world seeks! You could go to space, ride motorcycles, climb the highest and coldest mountains, and pass through the thickest forests. Ultimately, quenching that thirst for adventure!

- 10 skins
- 1 free skin!
- Licensed by Team Snowflake and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Beach Party
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
This summer the party will never end on this exotic beach. Enjoy yourselves, drive around in a water scooter, chill out on a swimming ring, and after a long day partake in an unforgettable party while a DJ produces music!

+ Great for roleplaying with friends
+ Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Autumn Styles
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
The leaves are changing, the weather is changing, the world is changing! What better way to celebrate than with a new look? Here's some stylish Autumn-themed skins to spice up this fall!

+ Includes 10 boomtacular skins!

items.title: Zombies
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
These cute zombie mobs are decked out in some serious outfits and have style! Become a zombie king or a pretty zombie with flowers. These not so scary zombies are ready to create some chaos! 

-7 cool skins!
-By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Farm Life
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Fulfil your dream and become a real farmer. Take care of your animals or plant the fields with your tractor. Take your brand new plane for a spin. Protect your seeds from hungry monsters with your scarecrow. Roleplay with all your friends and expand your farm to become the most famous farmer.

+ Free skin
+ Plane
+ Tractor
+ Animals
+ Colour changes

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Wild West
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Traveling the wilderness? Then stop at the old western town. Explore with friends, even have a showdown. 
A small western town with two skins included.

items.title: Monitor Minds
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Has your style been static for too long? Plug in and update your wardrobe with this trendy pack. There are fun and fresh styles for every TV lover to choose from. Tap into the mainframe!

- 8 TV Head Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Back to School
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Fall is fast approaching, but you'll need some clothes first. Want to show off to all your classmates this coming school year? With these fits, walking to class becomes runway modeling! There's no better way to start your first day than putting on some of these beautiful back-to-school skins.

- 10 Trendy Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Night Life Teens
items.creator: TNTgames
items.description: A night in the town has never looked so stylish! Find your look with 10 unique designs in Night Life Teens.

items.title: Skater Kids
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Show off your epicness with this fresh new skateboarder look! Here's eight skater skins to get you started on your way to four-wheeled mastery!

+ Includes 8 boomtastic skins!

items.title: Zombie Parkour
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Parkour in a ruined city! Survivors of the zombie invasion have banded together but need your help to survive. Become a runner and grab vital supplies. Parkour across city ruins and run from the undead.
- Zombies and other mobs gain power at night
- Large city map designed for free running and parkour
- 8 blood-pumping music tracks
- Multiplayer parkour fun

Get running!

items.title: Stylish Mobs
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Dress up as a stylish mob! From cute foxes, to scary zombies, this pack has a skin for everyone!

+ 10 cool animal skins
+ Unique designs!

items.title: Demon Hackers
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Put your hacker masks on, let your horns show and get ready to troll all of your friends!

+ 10 cool teen skins
+ Masked hacker outfits

items.title: OP Mansion
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Live the rich life in this mansion. Built using diamond blocks, and stocked with chests filled with valuable blocks, this is the best way to start your survival world.

- Explore the mansion to find chests stocked with gold, iron, emeralds, diamonds and more!
- Includes a shulker box filled with OP netherite tools!

items.title: Factions Base
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Enjoy factions? Then this is the base for you! Built mostly underground, this base includes an enchanting room, iron golem spawner, loot room and more!

- Lots of rare valuables inside!
- Heavily protected, with obsidian and lava

items.title: Hacker Swords
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Hacker Swords is a base with the most powerful swords in Minecraft. Explore the base and find all the hacked tools! Hack your way to victory!

- Secret base
- Super weapons
- Overpowered tools!

items.title: Rainbow Fashion Cats
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Time to hit the cat walk! These felines know their fashion and have attitude like no other. Pouncing in with their purrfect pastel and rainbow colored outfits. Trendy, edgy, classic, cool! 11 rainbow fashion cat skins for you to choose from. Me-wow!
